lines.zh: 它把半个身子埋在沙里挪动。
lines.en: Half buried, it drags itself through the sand.

lines.zh: 六条腿在沙丘上留下乱纹。
lines.en: Six legs leave a tangle of trails on the dune.

lines.zh: 我从沙里露出两只颚尖。
lines.en: I show only two jaw tips above the sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠的热气里，沙子都在动。
lines.en: In the desert haze, even the sand stirs.

lines.zh: 沙子底下的我，看见你了。
lines.en: Under the sand, I see you.
The sand taught me to hide.

lines.zh: 沙子底下，我的眼珠跟着你转。
lines.en: Under the sand, my eyes track you.
It lifts a pair of mandibles out of the sand.

lines.zh: 沙钻进甲壳缝，磨得生疼。
lines.en: Sand works into my shell seams and grinds.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳碎了一块，沙灌进来。
lines.en: A piece of my shell broke; sand pours in.
Sand is grinding into my joints!
Come near, and I'll tear you apart!

lines.zh: 我的皮肤是天然防弹衣！
lines.en: My skin is a natural armor!
Your flesh is attractive to me!
My claws will tear you apart!
You're standing on my burrow mouth.

lines.zh: 我的洞口被你踩塌了一半。
lines.en: You've caved in half my burrow mouth.
This is my territory, get out!
I need to reproduce, find me!
My mate is the only one!
Food is running low, hunt more!

lines.zh: 热浪把你的味道送进沙里。
lines.en: The heat wave carries your scent into the sand.
Your footprints are buried in the sand.

lines.zh: 沙纹往你脚边聚，是我在动。
lines.en: The sand ripples gather at your feet; that's me.

lines.zh: 沙丘动了，它在等人踩上来。
lines.en: The dune shifts; it waits for a foot to land.

lines.zh: 你在沙漠里走，它跟着沙纹走。
lines.en: You cross the desert; it rides the ripples behind you.
The wind stops, and it smells something alive.

lines.zh: 它从岩壁的阴影里选了你。
lines.en: From the shade of the cliff it picks you.
Its plating tightens plate by plate.

lines.zh: 你踩塌的那个洞，是它的门。
lines.en: The hole you caved in was its door.

lines.zh: 我把身子埋进沙，只留颚。
lines.en: I bury myself, leaving only my jaws out.

lines.zh: 沙子底下，我等着你踩空。
lines.en: Under the sand, I wait for your misstep.
Half buried in sand, I wait for you to pass.

lines.zh: 沙面下，我的尾巴绷紧了。
lines.en: Beneath the sand, my tail pulls taut.

lines.zh: 我的每一节甲都对准你的脚踝。
lines.en: Every segment of my armor aims at your ankle.
It lines up on your ankle.

lines.zh: 沙面鼓起，朝你的方向推来。
lines.en: The sand bulges and pushes toward you.
It opens its mandibles as wide as they go.

lines.zh: 它在沙下数着你的步子。
lines.en: Under the sand it counts your steps.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴翘起，准备弹动。
lines.en: Its tail lifts, ready to snap.

lines.zh: 它停在你影子边缘，等风。
lines.en: It stops at the edge of your shadow and waits for wind.
It sifts the grains aside and shows its eyes.

lines.zh: 它的身子压低，贴住地面。
lines.en: It flattens itself to the ground.

lines.zh: 它顺着热浪的方向靠近。
lines.en: It creeps along the heat shimmer.

lines.zh: 它选中了你露在外面的皮。
lines.en: It has chosen the skin you left bare.

lines.zh: 它的每一节都对准了角度。
lines.en: Every segment of it is set at an angle.

lines.zh: 它从沙里窜出，咬你的脚背。
lines.en: It bursts from the sand and bites your foot.

lines.zh: 沙尘扬起，它缠住了你的小腿。
lines.en: Dust flies; it coils around your calf.

lines.zh: 颚合上的声音，像石头相撞。
lines.en: Its jaws snap like stones knocking.

lines.zh: 它一甩尾，把沙撒进你眼睛。
lines.en: It flicks its tail and throws sand in your eyes.
It dives into the top of your boot.

lines.zh: 它在沙下翻身，把你绊倒。
lines.en: It rolls beneath the sand and trips you.

lines.zh: 它的尾刺挑破了你的手套。
lines.en: Its tail barb splits your glove.

lines.zh: 沙丘塌了，正好压在你身上。
lines.en: The dune collapses, right onto you.

lines.zh: 它咬住腰间的绳，把你往沙里拉。
lines.en: It grips your belt rope and hauls you into the sand.

lines.zh: 沙落定，只留下它的沙印。
lines.en: The sand settles, leaving only its mark.

lines.zh: 沙丘顶端的沙开始往下淌。
lines.en: Sand starts sliding off the dune's crest.

lines.zh: 你一转身，沙里有了动静。
lines.en: You turn, and the sand is already moving.

lines.zh: 沙里没有水，我也不会游。
lines.en: There is no water in sand, and I cannot swim.
Sand grinds my teeth and my stomach is empty.
